تخترطوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِطُوا (taḵtariṭū) /tax.ta.ri.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# تُخْتَرَطُوا (tuḵtaraṭū) /tux.ta.ra.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
